text: Given a valid Cloudflare API token in the credential header, When the agent calls cloudflare_list_zones, Then it returns the zones reachable by that token (id, name, status, plan), paginated with has_more set correctly
Given the Cloudflare credential header is missing, When any cloudflare_* tool is called, Then the service returns 401 with a body listing the required header name, not a 500
Given a zone_id, When the agent calls cloudflare_list_dns_records with type and name filters, Then only matching records are returned (id, type, name, content, ttl, proxied)
Given valid new-record fields (type, name, content; ttl/proxied optional), When the agent calls cloudflare_create_dns_record, Then a record is created and returned with its Cloudflare-assigned id

Given an existing record_id and only a subset of fields to change, When the agent calls cloudflare_update_dns_record, Then only those fields change and every other existing field on the record is preserved
Given an existing record_id, When the agent calls cloudflare_delete_dns_record, Then the upstream delete call is made and a success confirmation (deleted record id) is returned

Given a record_id that does not exist, When the agent calls cloudflare_update_dns_record or cloudflare_delete_dns_record, Then the tool returns a structured not_found error instead of raising an exception
Given a zone_id, When the agent calls cloudflare_purge_cache with mode="everything", Then a full-zone purge request is sent to Cloudflare and a success confirmation is returned

Given a zone_id and a list of urls/tags/hosts, When the agent calls cloudflare_purge_cache with mode="files"/"tags"/"hosts", Then only the targeted items are sent in the purge request, not a full-zone purge

Given the upstream Cloudflare API responds with 429 or a 5xx, When any tool calls it, Then the tool returns the structured error envelope (code rate_limited or upstream_error) after limited retries honoring Retry-After, instead of raising

Given two concurrent requests carrying different Cloudflare API tokens, When both call cloudflare_list_zones at the same time, Then each response contains only the zones reachable by its own token and neither token value appears in the other request's logs

Given a real Cloudflare account and a real API token, When cloudflare_list_zones is called against the live Cloudflare API, Then it returns that account's actual zones, confirming the mocked tests match the real v4 response shape
steps: Obtain a real Cloudflare API token scoped to Zone:Read on a test account/zone
Run the MCP server locally with MCP_HTTP_PORT default, send initialize then tools/call cloudflare_list_zones with the token in the X-Cloudflare-Api-Token header
Compare the returned zone list against what the Cloudflare dashboard shows for that account
expect: Returned zones (id, name, status, plan) match the dashboard; no error
notes: needs a real vendor account; not required before INT publish

text: Given a real test zone, When a DNS record is created then deleted via the live tools, Then the record is actually gone from Cloudflare's own DNS records list for that zone
steps: Using a real token, call cloudflare_create_dns_record on a disposable test zone (e.g. a TXT record)
Call cloudflare_delete_dns_record with the returned record id
Call cloudflare_list_dns_records (or the Cloudflare dashboard) for that zone and confirm the record is absent
expect: Record no longer appears in the zone's DNS record list
notes: needs a real vendor account; not required before INT publish

text: Given a real test zone with a cached asset, When cloudflare_purge_cache is called with mode="everything", Then a subsequent fetch of that asset shows a fresh cf-cache-status (MISS/EXPIRED) instead of HIT
steps: Fetch a cached asset on the test zone and confirm cf-cache-status: HIT
Call cloudflare_purge_cache with mode="everything" for that zone
Re-fetch the same asset and inspect cf-cache-status
expect: cf-cache-status is no longer HIT immediately after the purge call returns success
notes: needs a real vendor account; not required before INT publish
